fallback_note: Agent/Task spawning tool unavailable in this environment; review performed by apikey-domain teammate loading the test-master skill directly.
summary: Correct pyramid: 7 fast unit tests (single in-memory repo fake) + 3 integration tests on real embedded Mongo for unique-index enforcement and query resolution. Every TDD anchor from the task is covered; all assertions check real state (decoded entropy length, hash equality, lookup results, count, DuplicateKeyException), none are mock-call assertions. Tests are isolated with clean per-test state.

findings.finding: lastUsedAt is a contracted field for the Task-7 filter but no test pins it: that generate() leaves lastUsedAt null and that regenerate() resets a previously-stamped lastUsedAt to null. A regression that carries over a stale lastUsedAt would go undetected.
findings.suggested_fix: Add assertion(s): after generate, stored.getLastUsedAt() is null; stamp lastUsedAt on the stored row, regenerate, assert it is null again.

findings.finding: The IT proves index enforcement and query resolution but does not assert full field round-trip through Mongo (createdAt/lastUsedAt persist and read back). Minor — the entity is plain POJO with no custom converters, so risk is low.
findings.suggested_fix: Optionally assert createdAt is non-null and lastUsedAt round-trips after save+findByProjectId. Low priority.

findings.finding: generate_returnsPlaintextOnce overlaps with generate_storesHashNotPlaintext (both assert stored fields != plaintext). The distinct contract (plaintext IS returned AND the record exposes only hash+prefix) is thin but legitimate; keeping both is acceptable.
findings.suggested_fix: No change required; documented for transparency.
